blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.
blocks.zh: 分化变压器(DiTs)已经成为高真能图像合成的主导架构,然而它们却遭遇了训练缓慢的趋同和高计算成本. 最近两条工作线从互补角度解决了这个问题:通过将中间特性与预先训练的外部代表模型(如DINov2)相接来加速DiT培训,而代表自动编码器(RAE)则用从自我监督的特性中学习的紧凑的表示-空间表示器来取而代之. 然而,这些方法是孤立地制定和应用的: REPA仍然依靠像素-空间VAE进行潜在扩散,RAE没有利用加速扩散主干线的对接信号. 我们提出\textbf{UniRA},一个统一的框架,使夫妇代表的协调和代表自动编码为一个单一的目标。 UniRA学习了一种表示-空间表示器,其输出同时作为扩散靶和对齐主锚,因此表示器,扩散主干线,以及外部表示模型被协同优化. 我们给出了一个理论结果,表明这种联合优化在加快传播趋同的同时保持了外部模式的代表性质量,我们得出了平衡重建、调整和生成目标的原则性加权。 在ImageNet的类条件生成时为256*256和512*512,UnirA匹配或超过FID中最先进的DiTs(SD3,REPA,RAE),同时将培训步骤减少至5*. 我们进一步表明,统一代表空间支持改进零射分级和线性测试,确认生成和理解受益于共享、一致的潜在空间。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm for high-fidelity image and video generation ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ) . The shift from U-Net backbones to diffusion transformers (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) has enabled principled scaling, but training these transformers from scratch remains expensive: convergence typically requires millions of optimizer steps and large-scale compute. This cost motivates a growing interest in injecting representation learning signals into the diffusion backbone to accelerate training and improve sample quality.
blocks.zh: 传播模型已成为高真实度图像和视频生成的主要范例(Ho等人,2020年;Rombach等人,2022年;Peebles和Xie,2023年;Esser等人,2024年;Brooks等人,2024年). 从U-Net骨干转向扩散变压器(DiT)(Peebles and Xie,2023),使得原则规模化得以实现,但这些变压器从零开始的培训仍然很昂贵:趋同一般需要数百万个优化步骤和大规模计算. 这一成本促使人们日益关注将代表性学习信号注入传播骨干,以加快培训并提高样本质量。

blocks.en: Two complementary lines of work have emerged. First, Representation Alignment (REPA) ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and its variants ( Yu and others, 2025a ; Yu and others, 2025b ) accelerate DiT training by projecting the diffusion backbone’s intermediate features into the embedding space of a pretrained self-supervised representation model (e.g., DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) ) and aligning them with a cosine loss. This simple signal can cut training steps several-fold and improve FID. Second, Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) ( Li and others, 2024 ) and related representation-space tokenizers ( Wang and others, 2025 ; Chen and others, 2024 ) replace the pixel-space VAE ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) with a tokenizer whose encoder and decoder operate in a learned representation space, yielding a more compact and semantically meaningful latent for diffusion.
blocks.zh: 出现了两个相辅相成的工作领域。 第一,代表性一致(REPA)(Yu等人,2024年)及其变体(Yu等人,2025年a); Yu等人,2025b)加快DiT训练,将扩散骨干中间特征投射到预先训练的自我监督的表示模型(例如DINov2(Oquab等人,2024年)的嵌入空间中,使其与余弦损失一致. 这个简单的信号可以剪切训练步骤数倍,改进FID. 第二,代表自动编码器(RAE)(Li等人,2024年)和相关的代表-空间标注器(Wang等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年)将像素-空间VAE(Kingma and Welling,2014年;Rombach等人,2022年)更换为标注器,其编码器和解码器在学习的表示器空间中运行,产生更为紧凑,具有精密的传播潜质.

blocks.en: These two ideas are developed in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, inheriting its reconstruction–perceptual trade-off, while RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the backbone. We observe that they are two halves of a single problem: the representation space used for tokenization should also serve as the alignment target, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized rather than trained separately.
blocks.zh: 这两种想法是孤立发展的: REPA仍然依赖像素-空间 VAE 进行潜在传播,继承了它的重建-概念权衡,而RAE则不利用加速主干线的对齐信号. 我们认为,它们是单一问题的两个半部分:用于象征性化的表示空间也应当作为配合目标,因此,表示器、传播主干和外部表示模式是相互优化的,而不是单独培训的。

blocks.en: We present UniRA , a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们提出Unira,一个统一的框架,使夫妇代表制一致,代表制自动编码成一个单一的目标。 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • Unified objective. We learn a representation-space tokenizer whose output is simultaneously the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so reconstruction, alignment, and generation are co-optimized with a principled multi-objective weighting. • Theoretical guarantee. We prove that joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model (preventing collapse) while accelerating diffusion convergence, formalizing the intuition behind REPA and RAE. • Efficiency. On ImageNet 256 × 256 256{\times}256 and 512 × 512 512{\times}512 , UniRA matches or surpasses REPA, RAE, and SD3 in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5 × 5\times . • Shared representation. The unified latent supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a single aligned latent space.
blocks.zh: • 统一目标。 我们学习了一种表示空间的表示器,其输出同时是传播指标和对齐锚,因此重建、对齐和生成都与原则性的多目标加权相结合。 • 理论保障。 我们证明,联合优化可以保持外部模型(防止崩溃)的表达质量,同时加速扩散趋同,使REPA和RAE背后的直觉正式化. • 效率:在ImageNet上,256×256 256 {\tims}256和512×512 512 {\tims}512,UnirA匹配或超过REPA、RAE和FID中的SD3,同时将培训步骤减少最多5×5\时。 统一潜伏支持改进零射线分类和线性探测,确认生成和理解受益于单一对齐潜伏空间。

blocks.en: Unified objective. We learn a representation-space tokenizer whose output is simultaneously the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so reconstruction, alignment, and generation are co-optimized with a principled multi-objective weighting.
blocks.zh: 统一目标. 我们学习了一种表示空间的表示器,其输出同时是传播指标和对齐锚,因此重建、对齐和生成都与原则性的多目标加权相结合。

blocks.en: Theoretical guarantee. We prove that joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model (preventing collapse) while accelerating diffusion convergence, formalizing the intuition behind REPA and RAE.
blocks.zh: 理论保证. 我们证明,联合优化可以保持外部模型(防止崩溃)的表达质量,同时加速扩散趋同,使REPA和RAE背后的直觉正式化.

blocks.en: Efficiency. On ImageNet 256 × 256 256{\times}256 and 512 × 512 512{\times}512 , UniRA matches or surpasses REPA, RAE, and SD3 in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5 × 5\times .
blocks.zh: 效率。 在ImageNet 256 × 256 \ Times}256 和 512 × 512 512 \Times}512上,UnirA匹配或超过 REPA,RAE,以及FID中的SD3,同时将训练步骤减少最多5 × 5\Times.

blocks.en: Shared representation. The unified latent supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a single aligned latent space.
blocks.zh: 共有代表权。 统一潜伏支持改进零射线分类和线性探测,确认生成和理解受益于单一对齐潜伏空间。

blocks.en: Figure 1 sketches the motivation: REPA aligns the backbone but keeps a pixel VAE; RAE replaces the VAE but does not align the backbone; UniRA does both in one representation space.
blocks.zh: 图1描绘了动机:REPA调和骨干但保持像素VAE;RAE替换VAE但不调和骨干;UnIRA同时在一个代表空间中进行.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Motivation. REPA aligns the diffusion backbone with an external representation model but keeps a pixel-space VAE. RAE replaces the VAE with a representation tokenizer but does not align the backbone. UniRA unifies both: a single representation space serves as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor.
blocks.zh: 图1:动机。 REPA将扩散主干线与外部代表模型对齐,但保持像素空间VAE. RAE用表示符号代替VAE,但不对齐主干. UniRA统一了两者:单一的表示空间作为传播目标和对齐锚.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) trains diffusion models in the latent space of a VAE ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ; van den Oord et al., 2017 ; Razavi et al., 2019 ) for efficiency. DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) replaces the U-Net with a transformer backbone ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) , enabling scalable image synthesis. Rectified-flow variants such as Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) further improve sample quality and training stability. Score-based formulations ( Song et al., 2021 ) , EDM ( Karras et al., 2022 ) , and classifier guidance ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ; Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) provide the theoretical and practical grounding. Generative adversarial approaches ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ; Karras et al., 2019 ) offer an alternative paradigm. Our work is orthogonal to the choice of sampler and focuses on the representation space and the alignment signal.
blocks.zh: Lateent spission (Rombach等人, 2022年) 列车在VAE潜伏空间中的扩散模型(Kingma and Welling, 2014年;van den Oord等人, 2017年;Razavi等人, 2019年),以提高效率. 数字 (Peebles and Xie, 2023)用变压器骨干取代U-Net(Vaswani等人,2017年;Dosovitskiy等人,2021年),实现可伸缩图像合成. 稳定扩散3(Esser等人,2024年)和流量匹配(Lipman等人,2023年)等经校正的流变型进一步提高了样本质量和培训稳定性. 计分配方(Song等人,2021年),EDM (Karras等人,2022年),和分类指导(Dhariwal and Nichol,2021年;Ho and Salimans,2022年)提供理论和实践基础. Goodfellow等人,2014年;Karras等人,2019年)提供了另一种模式。 我们的工作对采样器的选择具有正统性,并侧重于表示空间和对齐信号.

blocks.en: REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) projects DiT intermediate features into the DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) embedding space and aligns them, accelerating training and improving FID. Extensions include REPA-E ( Yu and others, 2025a ) for efficient alignment and U-REPA ( Yu and others, 2025b ) for a unified alignment across layers. Related work studies subspace consistency ( Bardes and others, 2024 ) and representation alignment in vision-language models ( Wang and others, 2024 ) . Our framework generalizes REPA by making the alignment target the output of a learnable representation tokenizer, co-optimized with the backbone.
blocks.zh: REPA(Yu等人,2024年)将DiT中间特征引入DINov2(Oquab等人,2024年)嵌入空间并与之对齐,加快培训和改进FID. 扩展内容包括高效对接的REPA-E(Yu等人,2025a)和跨层统一对接的U-REPA(Yu等人,2025b)。 相关工作研究亚空间一致性(Bardes等人,2024年)和视觉语言模型中的表示一致性(Wang等人,2024年). 我们的框架概括了REPA,使调整目标成为可学习的表示器的产出,与骨干配合优化。

blocks.en: VQ-VAE ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ; Razavi et al., 2019 ) introduced discrete tokenizers for generation. RAE ( Li and others, 2024 ) proposes continuous representation auto-encoders that replace the pixel VAE with a representation-space tokenizer, showing improved sample quality and compactness. SRA-2 ( Wang and others, 2025 ) and VA-VAE ( Chen and others, 2024 ) extend this to self-representative and video-audio settings. Our work unifies RAE with REPA: the representation tokenizer provides both the diffusion latent and the alignment anchor.
blocks.zh: VQ-VAE(van den Oord et al.,2017;Razavi et al.,2019)引入了离散的代谢剂供一代使用. RAE(Li等人,2024年)提出连续表示自动编码器,将像素VAE替换为表示-空间表示器,显示样品质量和紧凑性得到提高. SRA-2(Wang等人,2025年)和VA-VAE(Chen等人,2024年)将此扩展至自我代表及视频-音频设置. 我们的工作将RAE与REPA统一起来:表示器既提供扩散潜伏,也提供对齐主机。

blocks.en: Self-supervised methods—contrastive ( Chen et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2020 ) , non-contrastive ( Grill et al., 2020 ; Zbontar et al., 2021 ) , and masked image modeling ( He et al., 2022 ) —learn powerful visual features without labels. Representation learning theory ( Bengio et al., 2013 ) and guillotine regularization ( Bordes et al., 2023 ) provide foundational analysis. DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) and DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) provide the representation models used as alignment targets in REPA. Vision-language models ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) and hierarchical backbones ( Liu et al., 2021 ) offer complementary representations. Topological orthogonality in visual tokenization ( Yang et al., 2026a ) and unified token spaces ( Yang et al., 2026d ; Yang et al., 2026c ) improve the quality and geometry of learned representations, motivating our use of a well-structured alignment target.
blocks.zh: 自我监督 方法 - 相容性(Chen等人,2020年;He等人,2020年),非相容性(Grill等人,2020年;Zbontar等人,2021年),以及蒙面图像模型(He等人,2022年) ——无标签的具有强大的视觉特征. 代表性学习理论(Bengio等人,2013年)和断头台规范化(Bordes等人,2023年)提供了基础分析. DINO(Caron等人,2021年)和DINOv2(Oquab等人,2024年)提供了REPA中用作对齐目标的表示模型. 愿景语言模型(拉德福德等人,2021年;扎伊等人,2023年)和等级骨干模型(刘等人,2021年)提供了互补的表示. 视觉标志化中的地形矫正(Yang等人,2026a)和统一标志空间(Yang等人,2026d); Yang et al., 2026c)) 提高学习表现的质量和几何性,激励我们使用结构合理的配对目标.

blocks.en: Whereas REPA aligns the backbone but keeps a pixel VAE, and RAE replaces the VAE but does not align the backbone, UniRA unifies both: a single representation space serves as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, jointly optimized. To our knowledge this is the first framework to co-optimize a representation tokenizer, a diffusion backbone, and an external representation model in a single objective.
blocks.zh: REPA对接主干线但保持像素VAE,RAE取代VAE但不对齐主干线,UnirA统一了两者:一个单一的表示空间作为传播目标以及对齐主锚,共同优化. 据我们所知,这是第一个在单一目标中合作优化代表表示器、传播骨干和外部代表模式的框架。

blocks.en:
The convergence acceleration follows the REPA argument ( Yu et al., 2024 ) : alignment injects a representation-learning gradient into the backbone, steering intermediate features toward a semantic manifold. Standard SGD analysis on a μ \mu -strongly-convex local surrogate shows that the effective learning rate along the representation direction scales with α \alpha , yielding a step reduction of O ⁡ ( 1 / α ) O(1/\alpha) . Combining the two gives the stated result.
∎
blocks.zh:
趋同加速遵循REPA的论据(Yu等人,2024年):趋同将一种表现学习梯度注入骨干,将中间特征引导到语义多元. 对μ \ mu – 强角局部代位的标准 SGD 分析显示,在 α → alpha 的表达方向表上的有效学习率, 导致 O → (1 / α ) O (1/\ alpha) 的分级减少 。 将两者结合起来就能得到所宣称的结果。
∎

blocks.en: Theorem 3.1 formalizes the intuition that coupling alignment and auto-encoding is mutually reinforcing: the tokenizer’s quality bounds the alignment target, and the alignment accelerates the backbone that consumes the tokenizer’s output.
blocks.zh: 定理3.1将连接对齐和自动编码的直觉正式化:标致器的质量约束着对齐目标,对齐加速了消耗标致器输出的骨干.

blocks.en: 3.5 Principled Multi-Objective Weighting
blocks.zh: 3.5 多目标加权

blocks.en: The three objectives compete for capacity. We balance them via a min-norm gradient (MGDA-style) search ( Sener and Koltun, 2018 ) over the gradients of ℒ gen \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{gen}} , ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{align}} , and ℒ rec \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}} , finding weights λ ∈ Δ 2 \lambda\in\Delta^{2} that minimize the norm of the combined gradient. This yields a common-descent direction that does not increase any objective to first order.
blocks.zh: 这三个目标争夺能力。 我们通过微调梯度(MGDA-tyle)搜索(Sener and Koltun, 2018)在L gen\ mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{ gen}的梯度,L 校正\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{ align}和L rec\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{rec}的梯度上进行平衡,找到将合并梯度的规范最小化的权重 λ λ 2\lambda\in\Delta\2}. 这产生一个共同的世系方向,不会将任何目标增加至第一。

blocks.en: 3.7 Scalability
blocks.zh: 3.7 可伸缩性

blocks.en: UniRA adds only a projector Π \Pi and the MGDA solver to a REPA+RAE pipeline, so the overhead is negligible (under 3 % 3\% ). The framework is compatible with any DiT variant ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) and any flow-matching or DDPM sampler ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Karras et al., 2022 ) , and scales to higher resolutions and video ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Blattmann and others, 2023 ) without changing the objective.
blocks.zh: Unira在 REPA+RAE 管道中只增加了一个投影器 \\ Pi 和 MGDA 解析器,所以其间接费用可以忽略不计(在 3% 3\ ) 。 框架与任何DiT变体(Peebles and Xie, 2023;Esser等人, 2024)和任何流量比对或DDPM采样器(Lipman等人, 2023;Karras等人, 2022)兼容,并标注到更高的分辨率和视频(Brooks等人, 2024;Blattmann等人, 2023)而不改变目标.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented UniRA, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective for efficient diffusion generation. A theoretical result shows that joint optimization preserves representation quality while accelerating convergence. Experiments confirm that UniRA matches or surpasses REPA, RAE, and SD3 in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5 × 5\times , and that the unified latent improves representation quality. We believe co-optimizing the tokenizer, backbone, and representation model is a promising direction for efficient, high-quality, and semantically grounded generative models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了UniRA,一个统一的框架,使夫妇代表的协调和代表自动编码成为高效传播的单一目标。 理论结果显示,联合优化既能保持代表性质量,又能加速趋同。 实验证实,UniRA匹配或超过RAPA、RAE和FID中的SD3,同时将培训步骤减少最多5×5\时,统一潜伏提高代表质量。 我们认为,共同优化标本器、骨干和代表模型,是高效、高质量和精准的基因模型的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Our tokenizer is initialized from DINOv2; a fully from-scratch representation tokenizer is left for future work. Extending UniRA to video ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Blattmann and others, 2023 ) , unified multimodal token spaces ( Yang et al., 2026d ; Yang et al., 2026c ) , topological orthogonality ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , and object-centric settings ( Yang et al., 2026b ) are promising directions.
blocks.zh: 我们的代号器是从DINOv2初始化的;一个完全来自scratch的代号器留待未来工作. 将UniRA扩展至视频(Brooks等人,2024年;Blatmann等人,2023年),统一多式联运标志空间(Yang等人,2026d;Yang等人,2026c),地形矫正(Yang等人,2026a),以及以物体为中心的设置 (Yang等人,2026b)是很有希望的方向.

blocks.en: Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 影响说明

blocks.en: This paper develops more efficient diffusion generation methods, which could reduce the computational cost of training and deploying generative models—a positive environmental impact. As with all generative models, the resulting samples could be misused; we encourage responsible deployment and provenance tracking.
blocks.zh: 本文开发了更有效的传播生成方法,可以降低培训和应用基因模型的计算成本,这是一种积极的环境影响。 与所有基因模型一样,由此产生的样本可能被滥用;我们鼓励负责任地部署和追踪来源。

blocks.en: We expand the argument for Theorem 3.1 . The representation quality bound follows from the joint optimum: if E E collapses, ℒ rec \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}} grows (no reconstruction) and ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{align}} saturates at a trivial cosine, so the joint loss cannot be at its minimum; hence E E is bounded below in quality. The convergence acceleration follows the REPA argument: alignment injects a representation-learning gradient, and standard SGD analysis on a μ \mu -strongly-convex local surrogate gives a step reduction of O ⁡ ( 1 / α ) O(1/\alpha) . The no-degradation proposition follows from the MGDA common-descent property ( Sener and Koltun, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们扩展了定理3.1的论点。 表示质量约束来自联合优化: 如果 E 崩溃, L rec \ mathcal{ L}_{\ mathrm{rec}} 生长(无重建), L 将 & mathcal{ L}_{\ mathrm{ align}} 饱和度在微小的余弦上对齐, 所以联合损失不能是最小的; 因此 E E 质量被限制在以下 。 趋同加速遵循REPA的论点:趋同注入了一种表示-学习梯度,而标准SGD对μ \ mu-强角局部代位的分析则使O → (1 / α) O(1/\ alpha) 的渐减. 无降解命题来源于MGDA共同世系(Sener and Koltun, 2018).
